SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch,
REPORT
File No. ____
Date May 20, 1935.

Subject Communication dated April 29, 1935, from the Netherlands
Consulate-General re: Russian Ballet Dancers.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Enquiries regarding the individuals mentioned in
the attached communication from the Netherlands Consulate-
General dated April 29, 1935 elicit the following information:-

1. Nicolay Alexandrovitch Griaznoff (stage name
Svetlanov), Soviet citizen, born on December 13, 1907, at
Leningrad. He was educated in the Middle School at Leningrad
and Kiev and also studied in the Ballet Studio at the latter
city. In 1928 he arrived in Harbin from Vladivostok
together with his step mother, Mrs. Griaznoff, who also is his
stage partner. In Harbin he was employed until 1932 in
various theatres, cabarets and restaurants. During this period
he also made three artistic tours in Japan. In 1932 Griaznoff
arrived in Shanghai and worked in the same capacity at Tkachenko's
Cafe, Astor House etc. In 1934, together the Fokin's Ballet
Company, he left for Manila, from which city he proceeded to
Java, Netherlands India, where he remained for 6 months. He
returned to Shanghai about 7 months ago and at present is
employed at the Paris Theatre, Avenue Joffre. He resides
at No. 117 Route Vallon.

2. Mrs. Alexandra Griaznoff, Soviet citizen, born
on December 1894 at Kiev. She is a professional ballet dancer.
Her husband, Mr. A. Griaznoff, is an employee of the Chinese
Eastern Railway at Harbin. She arrived in Harbin from
Vladivostok in 1928 together with her step son, and stage partner
N.A. Griaznoff and later accompanied him in his artistic tours
to Japan, Manila and Java. She resides at No. 413 Rue
Cardinal Mercier.

Both N.A. Griaznoff and Mrs. A. Griaznoff, although
Soviet citizens, are not known to be connected with any political
activities.

针对1935年4月29日荷兰总领事馆附函中提及的个人进行的查询，获得如下信息：-

1. 尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇·格里亚兹诺夫（Nicolay Alexandrovitch Griaznoff）（艺名
斯维特兰诺夫 Svetlanov），苏联公民，1907年12月13日出生于
列宁格勒。他在列宁格勒和基辅的中学接受教育，并在后者的芭蕾舞工作室学习。1928年，他与继母格里亚兹诺夫夫人（Mrs. Griaznoff）一同从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨，其继母也是他的舞台搭档。在哈尔滨，他直到1932年受雇于各家剧院、歌舞厅和餐馆。在此期间，他还曾在日本进行过三次艺术巡演。1932年，格里亚兹诺夫抵达上海，在特卡琴科咖啡馆（Tkachenko's Cafe）、礼查饭店（Astor House）等地从事相同工作。1934年，他随福金芭蕾舞团（Fokin's Ballet Company）前往马尼拉，随后从该市前往荷属东印度的爪哇，在那里停留了6个月。他大约7个月前回到上海，目前受雇于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的巴黎大戏院（Paris Theatre）。他居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）117号。

2. 亚历山德拉·格里亚兹诺夫夫人（Mrs. Alexandra Griaznoff），苏联公民，1894年12月出生于基辅。她是一名职业芭蕾舞演员。她的丈夫 A. 格里亚兹诺夫先生是哈尔滨中东铁路的雇员。她于1928年与继子及舞台搭档 N.A. 格里亚兹诺夫一同从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨，随后陪同他前往日本、马尼拉和爪哇进行艺术巡演。她居住在梅白尔神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）413号。

N.A. 格里亚兹诺夫和 A. 格里亚兹诺夫夫人虽均为苏联公民，但据知并未参与任何政治活动。

3. Mrs. Ludmila Constantinovna Nikitina, Russian
Emigrant, born on July 25, 1908 at Verkhneudinsk, Transbaikal
Province. She arrived in Harbin as a child and was educated
in a Commercial School and subsequently at Trutovsky and
Eliroff's Ballet Studio in that city. Later she was employed
in various cabarets and restaurants at Harbin for some time,
after which she left for Shanghai with a ballet dancers'
company. She worked here at Tkachenko's Cafe etc. until 1934
when she left for Manila and Java with Fokin's Ballet Company.
About 7 months ago she returned to Shanghai and has since been
working locally in her professional capacity. She is reported
to be the paramour of N.A. Grismzoff, and at present resides
at No. 117 Route Vallon.

4. Mrs. Helena Fedorovna Kondireff, nee Wiedeman,
Russian of Esthonian origin and British subject by marriage,
was born on December 3, 1911 at Vladivostok. In 1919 or 1920
she left Vladivostok for Reval, Estonia, together with her
parents. She was educated in the Russian Middle School in
Reval and subsequently attended a Ballet School in that city.
Later she worked as a ballet dancer in various towns in Estonia
and Finland. In 1929 she left for Paris where she attended
Hlustin's Ballet School. In 1930 Mrs. Kondireff-Wiedeman went
to Egypt, where she performed as a ballet dancer at Alexandria
and Port Said for a few months, after which she went to Greece.
In 1931 she proceeded to Australia to her mother, who resided
with her second husband in Brisbain, Queensland. In Australia
Kondireff-Wiedeman worked in her professional capacity in various
towns. In 1932 she married one Peter John Kondireff, a
naturalized British subject of Russian origin, who formerly was

4. 海伦娜·费奥多罗夫娜·孔迪列夫夫人（Mrs. Helena Fedorovna Kondireff），娘家姓维德曼（Wiedeman），爱沙尼亚裔俄国人，因婚姻成为英国臣民，1911年12月3日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克。1919年或1920年，她与父母一同离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往爱沙尼亚的雷瓦尔（Reval）。她在雷瓦尔的俄国中学接受教育，随后在该市的一所芭蕾舞学校就读。后来，她在爱沙尼亚和芬兰的各个城镇担任芭蕾舞演员。1929年，她前往巴黎，在赫卢斯廷（Hlustin）芭蕾舞学校学习。1930年，孔迪列夫-维德曼夫人前往埃及，在亚历山大港和塞得港作为芭蕾舞演员表演了几个月，之后前往希腊。1931年，她前往澳大利亚投奔其母亲，后者与其第二任丈夫居住在昆士兰州的布里斯班（Brisbain，原文如此）。在澳大利亚，孔迪列夫-维德曼在各个城镇从事其专业工作。1932年，她嫁给彼得·约翰·孔迪列夫（Peter John Kondireff），后者是归化英国臣民，俄裔，此前曾是

5. Miss Anna Reuter is Russian Emigrant of Jewish
origin, who was born on March 2, 1912 at Harbin. She arrived
in Shanghai in 1910 together with her mother, brother and
sisters. She was educated in St. Joseph Convent in Shanghai,
after which she was employed for about 5 years with R.F.Pirard,
No. 22 Nanking Road, as a typist and stenographer. Since 1934
she has been employed with Paul E. Sarmann & Co., No. 33
Szechuen Road. Miss Reuter has been a pupil of the
Svetlanova's Ballet Studio for the past several years. She
appeared on the stage during the performances of the studio
in question at various charity functions. She resides with
her mother at No. 321 Rue Cardinal Mercier.
6. Vera Nikolaevna Sinizina, Russian emigrant, born on
November 23, 1913 at Moscow. She arrived at Harbin in 1918
together with her parents. She was educated in Harbin Normal
School and later was employed with various ballet companies in
that city and appeared in cabarets, restaurants, etc. About
three years ago she visited Japan with Yanover & Ratushenko's
Ballet Company. In 1934 she arrived in Shanghai and since that
time has not been working on the stage. It is reported that
for the past few years she has been cohabiting with one W.R.
Marchman, an employee of the National City Bank. She resides
at No. 1182 Avenue Road, flat 21.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1521.

SHANGHAI, 29 April 1935.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I received applications
to-day for visa for admission into The Netherlands Indies from the
following persons.

1. Nikolas GRIAZNOFF, a dancer, born at Leningrad, 13 December 1907,
residing at 117 Rte Vallon, a Soviet citizen, holder of a U.S.S.R.
passport issued at Vladivostok on 13 January 1926, No.109579/
762101, extended for the last time at Shanghai on 6 June 1934
and valid until 24 July 1935.

2. Alexandrine GRIAZNOFF, a dancer, born at Kiev, 8 December 1894,
residing at 413 Rue Card.Mercier, a Soviet citizen, holder of a
similar passport No.109556/762077 and extended locally on the
same date.

3. Mrs. Ludmilla Constantinovna NIKITINA, a dancer, born at Verk-
hneudinsk on 25 July 1908, residing at 117 Rte Vallon, holder
of a Chinese passport No.8879 issued by the local Bureau of Pub-
lic Safety on 15 December 1933, which has expired.

4. Mrs. Helen KONDIREFF née Wiedeman, a dancer, born at Vladivostok,
3 December 1911, residing at 12 Harmony Terrace, a British sub-
ject by marriage, wife of Peter John Kondireff, a British sub-
ject by naturalisation (Imperical Certificate No.A A 8294, issued
at Canberra on 7 June 1932), holder of a passport issued by the
local British Consulate General on 23 April 1935.

5. Miss ~~Alexandra A.~~ Arina REUTER, a stenographer-dancer born at Harbin on
2 March 1912, residing at 674 Rue Lafayette, holder of a re-
gistration certificate, No.2662, issued by the local Bureau of
Public Safety on 28 August 1934.

6.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海，1935年4月29日。

先生：

谨此通知您，我今日收到以下人员申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

1. 尼古拉斯·格里亚兹诺夫（Nikolas GRIAZNOFF），舞者，1907年12月13日出生于列宁格勒，居住在瓦隆路117号，苏联公民，持有1926年1月13日在符拉迪沃斯托克签发的苏联护照，号码109579/762101，最后一次在上海延期至1934年6月6日，有效期至1935年7月24日。

2. 亚历山德里娜·格里亚兹诺夫（Alexandrine GRIAZNOFF），舞者，1894年12月8日出生于基辅，居住在梅白尔神父路413号，苏联公民，持有类似护照，号码109556/762077，并于同日在当地延期。

3. 柳德米拉·康斯坦丁诺夫娜·尼基京娜夫人（Mrs. Ludmilla Constantinovna NIKITINA），舞者，1908年7月25日出生于上乌丁斯克，居住在瓦隆路117号，持有1933年12月15日由当地公安局签发的中国护照，号码8879，该护照已过期。

4. 海伦·孔迪列夫夫人（Mrs. Helen KONDIREFF），娘家姓维德曼，舞者，1911年12月3日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克，居住在和谐里12号，因婚姻成为英国臣民，系彼得·约翰·孔迪列夫之妻，后者为归化英国臣民（帝国证书号码 A A 8294，1932年6月7日签发于堪培拉），持有1935年4月23日由当地英国总领事馆签发的护照。

5. ~~亚历山德拉·A.~~ 阿里娜·罗伊特小姐（Miss Arina REUTER），速记员-舞者，1912年3月2日出生于哈尔滨，居住在拉斐特路674号，持有1934年8月28日由当地公安局签发的注册证，号码2662。

6.

T.P. 吉文斯 先生（T.P.Givens, Esquire），
副总监（特别支部），

Later I received a visit from Mr.Hal P.Mills, manager of
the Consolidated Amusement Co., 111 Astor House Hotel, who stated
that the above persons were engaged by him for the Club Chanteclaire
at Soerabaia.

I should be much obliged if you could let me know whether
there is anything against the above persons from a political or
moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,

格里亚兹诺夫先生由一位格拉泽尔先生（Mr. GLAZIER）介绍给我，后者为他担任翻译。

随后，联合娱乐公司（Consolidated Amusement Co.，地址：礼查饭店111号）经理哈尔·P·米尔斯先生（Mr. Hal P. Mills）来访，他表示上述人员是他为泗水（Soerabaia）的香特克莱尔俱乐部（Club Chanteclaire）聘用的。

如蒙告知上述人员在政治或道德方面是否有任何不良记录，我将不胜感激。

敬意，
